mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_team ( team_id, activity_id, goods_id, target_count, complete_count, lock_count, team_status, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, create_time ) values ( #{teamId}, #{activityId}, #{goodsId}, #{targetCount}, #{completeCount}, #{lockCount}, #{teamStatus}, #{validStartTime}, #{validEndTime}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update: update group_buy_team set lock_count = lock_count + 1 where team_id = #{teamId} and team_status = 'PROCESSING' and lock_count < target_count and (valid_end_time is null or valid_end_time > now())
update group_buy_order_lock set lock_status = 'PAID' where order_id = #{orderId} and lock_status = 'LOCKED'

update group_buy_team set complete_count = complete_count + 1, team_status = case when complete_count + 1 >= target_count then 'SUCCESS' else team_status end where team_id = #{teamId} and team_status = 'PROCESSING' and complete_count < target_count
mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_order_lock ( lock_id, idempotent_key, user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, goods_id, lock_amount, lock_status, lock_time ) values ( #{lockId}, #{idempotentKey}, #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{orderId}, #{activityId}, #{goodsId}, #{lockAmount}, #{lockStatus}, #{lockTime} )
mapper.select: select id, lock_id, idempotent_key, user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, goods_id, lock_amount, lock_status, lock_time from group_buy_order_lock where idempotent_key = #{idempotentKey} limit 1
select id, lock_id, idempotent_key, user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, goods_id, lock_amount, lock_status, lock_time from group_buy_order_lock where order_id = #{orderId} limit 1
select id, team_id, activity_id, goods_id, target_count, complete_count, lock_count, team_status, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, create_time from group_buy_team where team_id = #{teamId} limit 1
select order_id from group_buy_order_lock where team_id = #{teamId} and lock_status = 'PAID'
mapper.update: update group_buy_order_lock set lock_status = 'RELEASED' where order_id = #{orderId} and lock_status = 'LOCKED'
update group_buy_order_lock set lock_status = 'RELEASED' where order_id = #{orderId} and lock_status = 'PAID'
update group_buy_team set lock_count = greatest(lock_count - 1, 0), complete_count = greatest(complete_count - 1, 0) where team_id = #{teamId}
